paragraphs: Comprise Technologies designs, builds, and markets public-use technology for libraries, school districts, and municipal government agencies. The stated aim is to reduce staff involvement while improving data security and privacy protection.

For libraries and schools the products cover PC, time, and print management. Wireless printing and booking and calendar services sit alongside those tools. On the payments side the company offers point-of-sale systems, self-service kiosks, and online payments taken from the customer's own website. A retail payment card system is listed among the product lines.

Because the software runs on a customer's behalf, the site says the company may hold personally identifying information and payment card data, and that it encrypts that information at all times while in its possession. Only authorized, trained personnel have access to that information. The company states that it will not share or sell the data to any third party except law enforcement presented with a valid court order. The mailing address given is in Navesink, New Jersey. A Brunswick satellite office is also listed.

quote.text: Comprise designs, builds and markets public-use technology solutions for libraries
